During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] subjected the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] to an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] '''bombardment'''.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="Barrow Oicunn in the Databank">{{DB|character|ltoicunn|Oicunn, Lieutenant}}</ref>

==Background==
[[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] was an ancient [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] and a [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founder]]. It was the capital world of a rich and heavily industrialized [[Humbarine sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones: Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The planet was also loyal to the Republic during the Clone Wars, thus making it a target for the Separatists.

==The bombardment==
Some time following the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|conquest of Duro]], a CIS fleet under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] flagship [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] launched several assaults on Humbarine.<ref name="Barrow Oicunn in the Databank" /> This included an hour-long [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that melted the crust of the planet, thus destroying the planetwide metropolis and presumably killing much of the population.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections" /><ref name="Barrow Oicunn in the Databank" />

==Aftermath==
Survivors from the sector defense forces, like [[Barrow Oicunn/Legends|Barrow Oicunn]], were relocated to other Republic units for the remainder of the war.<ref name="Barrow Oicunn in the Databank" /> With additional planets in the sector falling to the CIS,<ref name="Bana Breemu in the Databank">{{DB|character|banabreemu|Breemu, Bana}}</ref> the entire Humbarine sector was eventually considered lost to the Separatists and abandoned by the Republic.<ref name="Barrow Oicunn in the Databank" />

The battle, along with CIS assaults on twenty-six strategic Loyalist worlds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and the release of the [[Brainrot Plague|Loedorvian Brain Plague]] into the [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]] (which wiped out almost every [[Human/Legends|Human]] there), likely contributed to much of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] policies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections" />
